title: Goonjti Hai Ye Sada
body:
Husaina Husaina, Haaye Husaina
Asr Ke Hangaam Mein Goonjti Hai Yeh Sada
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ho Gaya Paamaal Jab Qasim(as) Ibn-e-Hasan(as)
Bain Yeh Karne Lagi Laash Pe Maa Khashta Tan
Nargah-e-a'daa Mein Ab Ghir Gaya Tera Chacha
Husaina Husaina, Haaye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hazrat Abbas(as) Ke Jab Hue Shaane Qalam
Aa Ke Laashe Pe Yeh Kehte The Shah-e-Umam
Asr Ko Kat Jaaye Ga Ab Mera Pyaasa Gala
Husaina Husaina, Haaye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Marne Se Abbas(as) Ke Toot Gayi Hai Kamar
Mar Gaya Beta Jawaan, Kuch Nahi Aata Nazar
Zulm-o-Sitam Dhaate Hain Dasht Mein Ab Ashqiya
Husaina Husaina, Haaye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sajda-e-Aakhir Mein Jab Tu Ne Jhukai Jabeen
Karnay Juda Sar Tera Aa Gaya Shimr La'een
Peet Ke Sar Charkh Par Kehne Lage Ambiya
Husaina Husaina, Haaye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Teri Museebat Pe Bhi Reham Na Khaya Koi
Pher Di Beta Tere Sookhe Gale Par Chhuri
Padhti Hain Nauha Yehi Laash Pe Ab Fatima(sa)
Husaina Husaina Hayye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ay Shah-e-Karbobala Dekh Ke Ghurbat Teri
Seena-o-Sar Peet Kar Roti Hai Khud Bebasi
Ghordon Se Pamaal Ab Hoyega Laasha Tera
Husaina Husaina Hayye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Laasha-e-Mazloom Par Karti Hai Zainab(sa) Yeh Bain
Bin Tere Bhai Mujhe Kis Tarah Aayega Chain
Pochnay Wala Yahan Ab Nahin Koi Mera
Husaina Husaina Hayye Husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Padhta Hai Hasnain Jo Ro Ke Yeh Nauha Nazar
Aur Azadaron Ka Phat'ta Hai Gham Se Jigar
Kehke Yehi Fatima(sa) Deti Hain Sab Ko Dua
Husaina Husaina Hayye Husaina
